# ImplodeArgumentsOrder

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `ImplodeArgumentsOrderInspection`

`implode()` historically accepted its separator in either position; passing the
pieces first and the separator second is deprecated (7.4) and removed (8.0).
When the second argument is clearly the separator (a string literal), the
arguments are swapped.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{3,4} [Before]
<?php

$csv   = implode($cells, ';');
$path  = \implode( $segments ,  "/" );
$ok1   = implode(' | ', $labels);
$ok2   = implode($labels, $sep);
$ok3   = implode($labels);
$ok4   = join($labels, '-');
```

```php [After fix]
<?php

$csv   = implode(';', $cells);
$path  = \implode("/", $segments);
$ok1   = implode(' | ', $labels);
$ok2   = implode($labels, $sep);
$ok3   = implode($labels);
$ok4   = join($labels, '-');
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: Pass the separator as the first argument of implode().</li>
<li>line 4: Pass the separator as the first argument of implode().</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "ImplodeArgumentsOrder": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore ImplodeArgumentsOrder

/**
 * @noinspection ImplodeArgumentsOrderInspection
 */
```
